references.role: Existing local handheld-game style/pixel-scale reference only; inspected, not copied into source or shipped art.

notes: Inspected both new honeydew fronts and close rear portraits at native size and 8x. Gold liquid-drop reservoirs dominate rounded purple ant bodies; small scoop jaws and cupped feet replace oversized tusks and rigid armor. White eye windows and black pupils remain readable; six Dewdant eye pixels and one Barricant eye pixel are guarded native refinements. Fronts face left and rear heads face away toward upper right. Exact original palettes retained.
